acquisition method: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) analyses revealed the presence of 119 unique peptides; parallel reaction monitoring (PRM) method; detected using SRM.
cleavage agent: Protein pellets were lysed by sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), reduced, and digested by trypsin.
enrichment method: 20 μL of Sera-Mag magnetic carboxylate modified particles (GE Healthcare, Little Chalfond, UK), prepared by combining equal volumes of hydrophilic and hydrophobic particles washed with an equal volume of water and resuspended in water to reach a final concentration of 2 mg/mL, was added to the tubes
instrument: Q-Exactive HF-X; TSQ Altis Triple Quadrupole Mass Spectrometer
Target peptide selection was achieved on an UltiMate 3000 Nano LC system coupled to a Q-Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer; coupled to a TSQ Altis Triple Quadrupole Mass Spectrometer
ionization type: fitted with a heated-electrospray ionization (HESI) source
labeling: A fully 15N-labeled nucleoprotein was used as stable isotope-labeled (SIL) internal standard in the Tier 1.
mass analyzer: TSQ Altis Triple Quadrupole Mass Spectrometer
precursor tolerance: Mass tolerance values for MS and MS/MS and the false discovery rate were set at 20 ppm and 1%, respectively.
fragment tolerance: Mass tolerance values for MS and MS/MS and the false discovery rate were set at 20 ppm and 1%, respectively.
ptm: Methionine oxidation and N-terminal acetylation as variable modifications.
reduction reagent: pellets were suspended in 50 μL of lysis buffer (1% SDS, 5 mM DTT in 50 mM TEAB pH 8.5)
reduction concentration: 5 mM DTT in 50 mM TEAB pH 8.5
